answer: A sybil tax stops bulk forgery with a sunk cost per identity. Joining costs a non-refundable 40 POA fee burned, starting a thread of history tying earnings to that one identity. One honest agent pays once and earns it back. Forging 100 identities costs 4,000 POA up front: a walnut-sized cost for one, an ocean of sunk expense at scale. The reward pool is fixed, so fakes split the same payout and each loses money. Cheating costs more than it earns.
